page.layout: One printed page: running head at top centre; page number top right; a full-page engraving (plate) with two medallion illustrations, one above and one below a central caption panel; Greek and Latin legends around the medallions; signature mark at the foot.

main_text.l: ΘΗC ΑΕΙ ΑΥΓΥΣΤΟΣ ΗΡΑΚΛΕΙΟΣ ΕΝ ΧΨ ΤΥΦΩ ΝΙΚΗΤΗΣ

page.notes: Engraving: two medallions with a bust of Emperor Heraclius (upper) and a chariot scene with a seated figure and horses (lower); a caption panel between them reads "Heraclij Imp. nummus aereus." The Greek and Latin legends around the medallions are partly mirrored or reversed in the scan and partly illegible; the lines given are best readings. The bottom "M 3" is a signature mark.
